jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF — Free Photo Converter
jpg-to-pdf.description: Combine JPG images into a PDF on your device. Reorder photos, choose A4 or original size, and export without a required account.
jpg-to-pdf.heading: A JPG photo, a shareable document.
steps: Choose one or more JPG photos from Files.
Put images in the order you want the PDF pages to appear.
Choose the page layout and margins, then create a PDF.
Review and download the PDF, or save it to your local workspace.

faqs.q: Can I combine several photos?
faqs.a: Yes. Arrange the imported images before creating the PDF. Each photo becomes a page according to your chosen layout.

faqs.q: Does this recognize words in the images?
faqs.a: This converter preserves the photos. To recognize printed words, open the separate OCR tool after conversion.

pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF to JPG — Free Page Image Export
pdf-to-jpg.description: Export PDF pages as JPG images locally. Choose the output resolution, then download your images without uploading the PDF.
pdf-to-jpg.heading: Take the pages you need as JPG images.
steps: Choose a PDF from your device.
For only a few pages, use Extract pages first and open the extracted PDF here.
JPG is selected for you; adjust the image resolution.
Convert and download the page images.

faqs.q: Can I choose only selected pages?
faqs.a: This converter exports every page of the supplied PDF. Use the separate Extract pages tool first to prepare a PDF containing only the pages you need.

faqs.q: Will the exported image contain selectable PDF text?
faqs.a: No. An exported page image is a raster picture; keep the original PDF for selectable text and vector content.

word-to-pdf.title: Word to PDF — Free DOCX Reading Copy
word-to-pdf.description: Make a basic PDF reading copy of a DOCX document in your browser. Local conversion preserves readable text; complex Office formatting is limited.
word-to-pdf.heading: A readable PDF copy of your DOCX document.
steps: Choose a DOCX file from your device.
Create the PDF reading copy using the Office-to-PDF tool.
Review the output, especially tables, charts, and multilingual text.
Download the PDF and retain the original Office file.

faqs.q: Will this exactly match Microsoft Office?
faqs.a: No. This tool makes a basic reading copy. Complex layouts, charts, and some table formatting are not reproduced.

faqs.q: Does the original file change?
faqs.a: The converter creates a separate PDF output. Your source Office file remains unchanged.

persian-ocr.title: Persian OCR — Extract Text from PDFs & Photos
persian-ocr.description: Recognize printed Persian text in scans and photographs. OCR runs locally with a dedicated language model and exports text or a searchable PDF.
persian-ocr.heading: Bring printed Persian / فارسی text into your workflow.
steps: Upload a clear scanned PDF or document photo.
The Persian recognition model is selected; choose text or searchable PDF output.
Start recognition and allow the language model to load on first use.
Review the recognized words, punctuation, and reading order before sharing.

faqs.q: Does this recognize handwriting?
faqs.a: The bundled OCR models focus on printed documents. Handwriting, decorative fonts, blur, and mixed reading order can reduce accuracy.

faqs.q: Is the language model uploaded with my document?
faqs.a: No. The model downloads to your browser; recognition runs on your device. Carefully review RTL punctuation and extracted reading order.

apple-pencil-pdf.title: Apple Pencil PDF Annotation — Free Browser Editor
apple-pencil-pdf.description: Write on PDFs with Apple Pencil or a digital stylus. Add editable handwriting, highlights, typed text, and export annotated PDFs on supported browsers.
apple-pencil-pdf.heading: Your handwriting, right beside the idea.
steps: Open a PDF in the reader and choose Pen.
Keep Draw with finger off when using a stylus.
Use two fingers to move and pinch the page; use the ? button for the gesture guide.
Save a PDF copy or keep editable ink in a local notebook.

faqs.q: Which Apple Pencil features work?
faqs.a: Pressure and tilt are used when the browser provides them. Native squeeze, double-tap, and haptics are not implemented in this web editor.

faqs.q: Can I use a different stylus?
faqs.a: Pen pointer events also support compatible digital pens on other devices. Hardware and browser behavior vary.
